new_result.statement: For disjoint original-coordinate banks I,J, if every high signed rank-one spectral mode has its I-projection in a subspace L or its J-projection in a subspace R, then compression to L^perp and R^perp annihilates the entire high packet exactly. With arbitrary-rank low packet of operator norm <=h and local tail ||T[I,J]||<=delta, s_k(A[I,J]) >= [s_k(U^T A0[I,J]V)-h-delta]_+.
new_result.cover_identity: The minimum sum of left/right footprint ranks over a partition of the modes equals the maximum cardinality of a subset simultaneously independent in the two vector matroids, by matroid intersection.
new_result.correction: A simultaneously left/right independent set does not force aggregate cross volume; Bell-paired modes can have common-independence number k while their total cross block is zero.

partner_applied.actual_application: Protected baseline 2 I_5 with h=delta=1/8 gives final s5(A[I,J])>=7/4 and ||p_Q||inf<=20sqrt(2e)/7=6.661839947420355..., with a continuous C0 representative in this D5 branch.

unresolved_implication: From bare s3(A)>=1, force either a low-dimensional two-sided spectral footprint cover with a surviving paid carrier, or prove that failure yields a cancellation-aware same-bank/Schur/grouped-hub/pair/diffuse receiver. Common left/right independence alone is insufficient.
next_step: Quantify the Bell-type cancellation alternative: show that large common-independence with small aggregate cross volume forces same-bank curvature or a Schur/pair certificate rather than trying to infer D5 directly.
continuity: proved only in the D5-covered branch; unrestricted continuity OPEN
